global: This miso ramen features a rich, golden broth with tender chashu pork, crisp menma, and a naruto fish cake, all topped with shredded daikon and green garnish. Served in a white bowl on a saucer, it gleams under soft lighting against a dark background.

regions.background: Dark, smooth, matte surface with subtle reflections and soft shadows around the bowl's base.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth with noodles, garnished with green herbs and shredded white topping, appears rich and creamy in the bowl.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice: light brown, tender-looking, curved, with visible fat marbling and slightly glossy surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, tender, and sliced into thin, slightly curved pieces with glossy, translucent surfaces.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: round, pale white with pink swirl, smooth surface, slightly textured edges.
